query:
SELECT
            CASE
                WHEN v.deleted_at IS NOT NULL THEN 0
                WHEN ov.visible IS NOT NULL THEN ov.visible
                WHEN v.hidden_at IS NULL THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END AS "visible!: i64"
         FROM videos v
         LEFT JOIN video_visibility_overrides ov
                ON ov.video_id = v.id
               AND ov.scope_kind = 'student'
               AND ov.scope_id = ?
         WHERE v.id = ?
